title: The Navy Pier ballroom today
summary: The interviewer says the ballroom is now a university gym and offers to show Levy, and mentions Jabbo played there this summer.

blocks.x: Well, they'd go to that ballroom because that's a big place.
Yeah, it was a big place. I don't know. They had a... I think they had a kind of a shell or some kind of acoustical thing there.
Yeah. If you'd like to go out there one of these times, I'll show you that ballroom.
It was a stage on the west side of it, and they played out toward the left. That's right. That's right. You've got to...
That's the way it is now. Mm-hmm.

And they've now converted that into the gymnasium of the University of Illinois. Oh. Uh-huh. But the ballroom, I'm sure, is about the same as it was before because all the structural beams are there. Mm-hmm.
That probably is just as you remember.
That's where we had Jabba this summer.
